'''Galena Rans''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who served as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A devoted citizen and retired decorated veteran of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[four-thirty-ninth bomber wing]] who [[Marriage/Legends|married]] [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] [[Rans]]. After Chancellor [[Jebevel Madon]] resigned, she was elected as the new Supreme Chancellor and she began to strengthen the Republic's [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] position.

==Biography==
[[File:Chancellor_Rans.png|thumb|175px|left|Supreme Chancellor Rans early during the Third Galactic War]]
Before [[Gender/Legends|her]] political career, Galena Rans used to be a [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] [[Wing Commander/Legends|wing commander]]<ref name="Codex" /> in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[four-thirty-ninth bomber wing]].<ref name="Onslaught" /> She would eventually [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] [[Rans]] and earned her status of veteran. This allowed her to keep close ties with the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].<ref name="State of the Galaxy" /> Galena Rans was a fierce critic of [[Leontyne Saresh]], and following her attempt to assassinate the [[Alliance Commander]], Rans rose to power.<ref name="Codex" /> After Chancellor [[Jebevel Madon]] resigned, she became Supreme Chancellor of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Onslaught" /> She counted with the support of Supreme Commander [[Jace Malcom]], which strengthened the Republic's position across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="State of the Galaxy" /> Her military background as a bomber wing commander allowed her to gain support from Republic hardliners, and her desire to give the Senate more power earned her support from people that believed that Saresh was a dictator.<ref name="Codex" />

==Personality and traits==
Following Galena Rans rise to chancellorship, she kept a charismatic attitude, a no-challenge-too-big confidence and the casual demeanor of a fighter pilot.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Galena Rans was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', specifically the<ref name="A Traitor Among the Chiss">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|A Traitor Among the Chiss}}</ref> [[2017]]<ref name="JUS Release Date">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11282017/game-update-5.6-traitor-among-chiss|text=Game Update 5.6: A Traitor Among the Chiss Patch Notes}}</ref> 5.6 ''A Traitor Among the Chiss'' update for the [[2016]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion.<ref name="A Traitor Among the Chiss" />

Rans first appearance was in the [[2019]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' expansion. Rans only appears in the Republic plotline of the expansion.<ref name="Onslaught" />

===Gameplay alternatives===
If the player aligns with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and kills [[Jace Malcom]] during the Iokath storyline, a news broadcast in the flashpoint "A Traitor Among the Chiss" states that Chancellor Madon resigned, and the Republic had an interim chancellor named Galena Rans.<ref name="A Traitor Among the Chiss" /> Alternatively, if the player sided with the Republic during the Iokath storyline and into the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion, Galena Rans will still be Supreme Chancellor.<ref name="Onslaught" />
